description: AbstractNotesFragment.kt defines an abstract Kotlin class for a notes UI fragment in an Android app, handling note display, selection, actions, and navigation.

classes.name: AbstractNotesFragment
classes.description: An abstract class managing UI logic for notes, including note display, selection mode, toolbar setup, and action menu handling.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the fragment UI components, sets up recycler view, listeners, and observes data.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Updates UI based on the latest notes data.

methods.name: onNotesChanged
methods.description: Submits the list of notes to the adapter.

methods.name: setupSecondaryToolbar
methods.description: Configures secondary toolbar actions based on selected notes.

methods.name: setSelectionModeUI
methods.description: Updates UI elements depending on note selection count.

methods.name: toggleNoteSelected
methods.description: Toggles selection state of a note.

methods.name: toggleLayoutMode
methods.description: Switches between list and grid layouts.

methods.name: toggleHiddenNotes
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of hidden notes.

methods.name: setHiddenNotesItemActionText
methods.description: Sets checkbox state for hidden notes menu item.

methods.name: applyNavToEditorAnimation
methods.description: Sets up shared element transition for navigation.

methods.name: showMenuForNote
methods.description: Displays contextual menu for a specific note with various actions.
